A refined beachfront home created for those who value privacy, understated luxury and effortless resort living. 

This beautifully designed 2-bedroom residence brings EDITION’s signature approach to sophisticated, intuitive living into a private home — combining contemporary interiors with uninterrupted beach views and direct beach access.
